data.name: Power Hover
data.detailed_description:
OVERVIEW
Power Hover is an action game about hoverboarding robots!
Defy gravity and enjoy the freedom of controlling an hoverboard! Navigate your way through the decaying world, avoid the hazards and collect the energy! Unfold the story of odd and desolate robot-world.



GAMEPLAY
The main goal in the game is to pass the levels and collect as much energy as possible.
Controls are simple: press left or right to steer the player around.
The hoverboard enables you to defy gravity and you often have to ride sideways and upside-down to pass the levels. Everything is tied together with a camera system which enables interesting angles and ensures the player stays in control at all times.



STORY
Someone has stolen all the power from your robot village, but the track is still warm, hop on your hoverboard and get the energy back!
As you ride your hoverboard through the game, a story about the odd and desolate world of the robots starts to unfold. Story is told through small interactive cutscenes.

FEATURES
• Over 35 hand crafted levels full of surprises!
• Defy Gravity and Enjoy the freedom of controlling a hoverboard.
• Enjoy beautiful pseudo-low-poly art style.
• Experience the story, told through small interactive cutscenes.
• Explore the beautiful landscapes and multiple different themes.
• Compete with your friends in the Challenge levels and in the Challenge mode.
• A thrilling soundtrack by Ted Striker.

data.short_description: Take control of the hoverboarding robots, explore the desolate world, defy gravity, dive into the oceans and ride with the sandworms on the dunes! Stylish graphics and groovy soundtrack will take you to an epic adventure in this action/racing game.
data.supported_languages: Inglês, Francês, Italiano, Alemão, Espanhol (Espanha), Japonês, Coreano, Português (Portugal), Russo

reviews.review:
[h1]A Peaceful Hoverboard Ride into the Nearest Laser - 4/10[/h1]
[h1]★ ★ ★ ★ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆[/h1]

[h3][i]Glide through a simple robotic world where the scenery is soothing and the obstacles are less welcoming.[/i][/h3]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Summary: 🤖🛹[/h2]
[i]A game centered in a battery-recovery road trip with a robot, a hoverboard, and a suspicious lack of brakes.[/i]
Power Hover combines the style of a mobile-like game with simple arcade controls and varied obstacle courses in a colorful in a minimalist world. It excels in its music while its hazards demand precision and practice

[hr][/hr]

[table]
    [tr]
        [td][b]📖 Story Quality:[/b][/td]
        [td][h3]★☆☆☆☆[/h3][/td]
        [td]
            [list]
                [*] A simple chase to recover the energy stolen from your robot village.
            [/list]
        [/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][b]📚 Story Depth:[/b][/td]
        [td][h3]★☆☆☆☆[/h3][/td]
        [td]
            [list]
                [*] Light on character development and detailed exposition.
                [*] Most of the storytelling rests on the atmosphere of the game.
            [/list]
        [/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][b]🎮 Controls:[/b][/td]
        [td][h3]★★★★☆[/h3][/td]
        [td]
            [list]
                [*] Just left and right. Easy to understand, trickier to master.
                [*] The drift feels slippery and sluggish.
            [/list]
        [/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][b]🌊 Immersive-ness:[/b][/td]
        [td][h3]★★★★☆[/h3][/td]
        [td]
            [list]
                [*] Atmospherical music, some quiet landscapes can create the 'flow-state'.
                [*] The robotic world feels lonely and slightly melancholic.
                [*] Relaxing to look at.
            [/list]
        [/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][b]🧩 Difficulty:[/b][/td]
        [td][h3]★★★☆☆[/h3][/td]
        [td]
            [list]
                [*] Easy to pick up. Simple game.
                [*] Regular stages require practice, route memorization and precise steering.
                [*] Uneven difficulty: a stage that takes repeated attempts in an uncomfortable way.
            [/list]
        [/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][b]🗺️ Level Design:[/b][/td]
        [td][h3]★★☆☆☆[/h3][/td]
        [td]
            [list]
                [*] Frequently introduces new hazards and situations without expanding the basic controls.
                [*] Changing camera perspectives make distances difficult to judge.
                [*] Again, uneven difficulty.
            [/list]
        [/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][b]🏞 Graphics:[/b][/td]
        [td][h3]★★★★★[/h3][/td]
        [td]
            [list]
                [*] A cohesive low-poly art style built around clean shapes, color and lighting.
                [*] The sparse look will not appeal to everyone.
            [/list]
        [/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][b]🔊 Sound(track):[/b][/td]
        [td][h3]★★★★★[/h3][/td]
        [td]
            [list]
                [*] Atmospheric electronic music fits the futuristic scenery and gliding movement beautifully.
                [*] The soundtrack helps you to get in the flow-state
            [/list]
        [/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][b]⚔ Gameplay:[/b][/td]
        [td][h3]★★★☆☆[/h3][/td]
        [td]
            [list]
                [*] Well suited to short sessions and the urge to try one more time.
                [*] The limited moveset can become monotonous.
            [/list]
        [/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][b]🐛 Bugs:[/b][/td]
        [td][h3]★★★★★[/h3][/td]
        [td]
            [list]
                [*] None found by me.
            [/list]
        [/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][b]⏱️ Playtime:[/b][/td]
        [td][/td]
        [td]~10–20hrs. Depends on playstyle[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][b]🔁 Replayability:[/b][/td]
        [td][h3]★★★☆☆[/h3][/td]
        [td]
            [list]
                [*] Missed batteries, three-star results, and higher survival scores provide reasons to return.
            [/list]
        [/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][b]💵 Price:[/b][/td]
        [td][h3]★★★☆☆[/h3][/td]
        [td]
            [list]
                [*] $1.30 feels too much for this game
                [*] May be in discount could be worth it.
            [/list]
        [/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]👌The good stuff✅[/h2]
[list]
    [*] Consistent minimalist visuals.
    [*] Atmospheric music that complements the world and movement.
    [*] Varied courses that make inventive use of simple controls.
    [*] Easy to start and convenient for short sessions.
[/list]

[h2]👎The bad stuff❌[/h2]
[list]
    [*] Strong inertia can make steering feel sluggish or imprecise.
    [*] Getting comfortable with the handling may take a substantial part of the campaign.
    [*] Camera changes sometimes make obstacles and collision paths difficult to read.
    [*] Difficulty spikes and sudden hazards can turn progress into trial and error.
    [*] Sometimes the game can feel repetitive or unfair.
[/list]
